1. E1 confirms that fiscal 2026 included a gain of $2.1 billion in "other gains and losses" driven primarily by fair value changes on equity investments.

2. E3 explicitly characterizes these fair value changes as "non-operating items" that "by their nature can fluctuate from period to period," directly supporting the notion that they mask operating performance. It confirms the $2.1 billion net gain in fiscal 2026.

3. E2 provides additional context about the fair value changes being driven by fluctuations in underlying stock prices.

The evidence establishes that: (a) net income for fiscal 2026 was affected by fair value changes on equity investments ($2.1 billion gain), and (b) these are explicitly described as non-operating items that fluctuate, which supports the characterization that they mask operating performance.
